id: work-redcomm
Membangun dan memelihara aplikasi internal enterprise untuk Redcomm Indonesia menggunakan Laravel, Nuxt.js, Docker, MySQL, dan Redis.
Merancang antarmuka pengguna yang responsif dan interaktif serta memberikan konsultasi teknis yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan klien dan stakeholder internal.
Memanfaatkan framework dan tool modern—termasuk Next.js, React.js, Astro.js, dan caching backend lanjutan—untuk menghadirkan solusi web berkinerja tinggi.
Mengelola version control dan kolaborasi menggunakan GitHub serta alat deployment internal khusus.
en: Built and maintained enterprise-grade internal applications for Redcomm Indonesia utilizing Laravel, Nuxt.js, Docker, MySQL, and Redis.
Designed responsive, interactive user interfaces and provided technical consultation tailored to client and internal stakeholder requirements.
Leveraged modern frameworks and tools—including Next.js, React.js, Astro.js, and advanced backend caching—to deliver high-performance web solutions.
Managed version control and collaboration workflows using GitHub along with specialized internal deployment tools.

id: work-web-developer
Mengembangkan website yang responsif dan interaktif berdasarkan kebutuhan dan minat klien.
Memberikan layanan konsultasi teknis untuk website klien.
Memanfaatkan teknologi modern seperti Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Astro.js, React.js, Next.js, dan GitHub.
en: Developed responsive and interactive websites based on client interests.
Provided consultation services for clients' websites.
Utilized the latest and modern technology stacks, including Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Astro.js, React.js, Next.js, and GitHub.

id: work-aslab
Mendampingi sesi praktikum untuk mata kuliah Sistem Digital, Pemrograman Berorientasi Objek, Pemrograman Mobile, Pemrograman Web, dan Basis Data.
Membimbing mahasiswa melalui latihan praktikum serta menjelaskan konsep fundamental dan aplikasi di dunia nyata.
Menyiapkan materi pendukung dan menangani troubleshooting teknis selama sesi praktikum di laboratorium.
Mengevaluasi hasil tugas mahasiswa dan memberikan umpan balik konstruktif untuk meningkatkan pemahaman dan performa.
Berkontribusi meningkatkan mutu pembelajaran laboratorium dengan pendekatan interaktif dan aplikatif.
en: Assisted in laboratory sessions for Digital Systems, Object-Oriented Programming, Mobile Programming, Web Programming, and Database courses.
Guided students through practical exercises, explaining fundamental concepts and real-world applications.
Prepared supporting materials and provided technical troubleshooting during lab sessions.
Evaluated student work and offered constructive feedback to improve understanding and performance.
Contributed to enhancing the quality of laboratory learning with interactive and hands-on approaches.

id: org-hmif-saintek
Memfasilitasi pengembangan akademik dan teknis mahasiswa Informatika melalui program kerja workshop, kelompok belajar, dan seminar teknologi.
Mengelola dan mengkurasi informasi mengenai kompetisi teknologi tingkat nasional (seperti GEMASTIK dan PKM) guna mendorong partisipasi dan prestasi mahasiswa.
Berkolaborasi menyelenggarakan 'Soedirman Technophoria', ajang nasional yang mencakup kompetisi web development dan seminar teknologi masa kini.
en: Facilitated the academic and technical development of Informatics students through work programs such as workshops, study groups, and technology seminars.
Managed and curated information regarding national-level tech competitions (such as GEMASTIK and PKM) to encourage student participation and achievement.
Collaborated in organizing 'Soedirman Technophoria', a national-level event featuring web development competitions and seminars to introduce emerging technologies to the public.

id: org-ssdc
Memimpin komunitas developer mahasiswa yang berfokus menciptakan iklim belajar kolaboratif dalam software engineering dan pemrograman.
Membentuk forum diskusi dan sesi studi rutin untuk memfasilitasi pertukaran wawasan terkait tech stack modern dan best practice industri.
Mengkoordinasikan keikutsertaan anggota dalam hackathon dan kompetisi coding, serta mengarahkan proyek open-source kolaboratif.
en: Led a student developer community focused on fostering a collaborative learning environment for software engineering and programming.
Established regular discussion forums and study sessions to facilitate knowledge sharing on modern tech stacks and best practices.
Coordinated member participation in hackathons and coding competitions, while also overseeing collaborative open-source projects to build practical portfolios.

Membuat konten dengan informasi tambahan bagi mahasiswa baru Unsoed.
Mengembangkan website Soedirman Student Summit yang memuat informasi penting bagi mahasiswa baru Unsoed.
en: A work program from the Student Resource Development Division of BEM-U Unsoed.
Collected data on new Unsoed students.
Created content with additional information for new Unsoed students.
Developed the Soedirman Student Summit website, containing essential information for new Unsoed students.

Menyusun rencana kegiatan menyeluruh, termasuk merumuskan tema, tujuan, dan format acara.
Mengkoordinasikan dan mendelegasikan tugas sesuai kompetensi serta tanggung jawab tiap anggota tim.
Merancang strategi komunikasi efektif guna menjaring peserta, termasuk optimalisasi media sosial.

Coordinated and delegated tasks according to the abilities and responsibilities of each team member.
Developed communication strategies to attract participants, including the use of social media.
